body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> SHARP presented its 37-inch LCD TV ''LC-37GP1U'' designed for gamers during CES 2007. By adopting Viper drive technology, it reduces the lag of response time between a game console and TV. It has 3 HDMI inputs and DVI input. External subwoofer can be connected as well. And its accompanying remote control has a dedicated game mode button.
